answer_2.quote: For the automatic evaluation, we adopt the extrinsic clustering evaluation metrics: B-Cubed Metrics , including B-Cubed precision, recall and F1.

answer_4.quote: We invite an expert to check the outputs of the models to evaluate whether the extracted events are complete and correctly clustered as well as whether all the events in text are discovered.
